Language Atlas

Česky

At the bottom is the common ancestor of the whole family, and the languages sit at the ends of the branches. Each ring is a place where a language split into several; the thicker the branch, the more languages grew from it. Big dots have a greeting. Drag to move, scroll or pinch to zoom, click a branch or a language.

✦ The gate to other worlds

The password mellon – Elvish for “friend” – opened it. These languages were not born on Earth but in books and films: writers and linguists invented them.

Sign languages

Sign languages are used mainly by Deaf people – with hands, face and the whole body. Each country has its own.
